parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Whether or not the hook is active. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: content_type
parameters.description: The media type used to serialize the payloads. Choices: "form" ← (default) "json"

parameters.name: events
parameters.description: A list of GitHub events the hook is triggered for. Events are listed at https://developer.github.com/v3/activity/events/types/. Required unless state=absent.

parameters.name: github_url
parameters.description: Base URL of the GitHub API. Default: "https://api.github.com"

parameters.name: insecure_ssl
parameters.description: Flag to indicate that GitHub should skip SSL verification when calling the hook. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password to authenticate to GitHub with.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description: Full name of the repository to configure a hook for.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: The shared secret between GitHub and the payload URL.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the hook should be present or absent. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Token to authenticate to GitHub with.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL to which payloads are delivered.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User to authenticate to GitHub as.

examples:
- name: Create a new webhook that triggers on push (password auth)
  community.general.github_webhook:
    repository: ansible/ansible
    url: https://www.example.com/hooks/
    events:
      - push
    user: "{{ github_user }}"
    password: "{{ github_password }}"

- name: Create a new webhook in a github enterprise installation with multiple event triggers (token auth)
  community.general.github_webhook:
    repository: myorg/myrepo
    url: https://jenkins.example.com/ghprbhook/
    content_type: json
    secret: "{{ github_shared_secret }}"
    insecure_ssl: true
    events:
      - issue_comment
      - pull_request
    user: "{{ github_user }}"
    token: "{{ github_user_api_token }}"
    github_url: https://github.example.com

- name: Delete a webhook (password auth)
  community.general.github_webhook:
    repository: ansible/ansible
    url: https://www.example.com/hooks/
    state: absent
    user: "{{ github_user }}"
    password: "{{ github_password }}"

return_values.name: hook_id
return_values.description: The GitHub ID of the hook created/updated. Returned: when state is ‘present’ Sample: 6206
